children.text:
- Opens from Aquarium "+ Add fish" and from Inventory TANK (that stack pre-picked).
- Shows every fish stack in the bag, best rate first. Tap a single fish = toggle selection.
- Tap a stack > 1 = Quantity modal: slider, -/+, quick 1 / Half / MAX; max = min(owned, free slots left). The cell then shows picked/owned (2/41). Setting 0 unpicks it.
- Bottom bar: thumbnails, count, Pearl rate after confirm, Clear, CONFIRM (n). One server call puts every picked fish in.
- If slots are full or selected > free, the confirm button disables and displays "Full" (no separate full screen needed).
children.name: Desc

children.text: Server: { Slots, MaxSlots, NextSlotPrice, Fish = { {Uid, Id, Mutation, Weight, Rate} }, Rate, OfflineCapHours } (remove targets Uid). Put in Tank sends PutInTank({ {Id, Mutation, Count} }) in one call, all-or-nothing: short on slots or fish = { ok = false, reason }, nothing added; client caps picks at free slots. Rate per fish = rarity base (Common 0.2 … Mythic 40) × mutation. Slots start at 3; expand 5k → 20k → 80k → 300k → 1M. Offline popup shows on join only when Pearls > 0. x2 button only when the player owns a 2x Pearls boost.
children.name: Desc
